request.prompt:
Project: antirez__kilo
Below are verified claims extracted from the sources. Write up to 8 overview claims that explain how the parts fit together (architecture, main flows, cross-cutting rules). Each overview claim must list the ids of the claims that support it.

Return: {"overview":[{"text":"one sentence, max 40 words","supports":["c3","c17"]}]}

c1 [README.md] Kilo is a small text editor implemented in under 1,000 lines of code as measured by cloc.
c2 [README.md] Kilo is executed from the command line using the syntax `kilo <filename>`.
c3 [README.md] Kilo uses CTRL-S to save, CTRL-Q to quit, and CTRL-F to search for strings in files.
c4 [README.md] Kilo has no library dependencies—not even curses—and relies on fairly standard VT100 escape sequences.
c5 [README.md] Kilo is in alpha stage and incorporates code borrowed from load81 and linenoise.
c6 [README.md] Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez) wrote Kilo and released it under the BSD 2 clause license.
c7 [kilo.c] enableRawMode registers editorAtExit via atexit, modifies termios flags to disable echo, canonical mode, and signals, and sets VTIME to 100ms.
c8 [kilo.c] editorReadKey decodes VT100 escape sequences into soft keycodes, returning DEL_KEY, PAGE_UP, PAGE_DOWN, arrow keys, HOME_KEY, or END_KEY.
c9 [kilo.c] Syntax match patterns starting with '.' match the extension at the end of the filename, while patterns without '.' search anywhere in the name.
c10 [kilo.c] editorUpdateSyntax recursively propagates syntax re-highlighting to following rows if the row's open comment state changes.
c11 [kilo.c] editorUpdateRow calculates expanded row buffer size for tabs, checking if allocsize exceeds UINT32_MAX, and exits if the line is too long.
c12 [kilo.c] editorInsertRow inserts an erow at index at, shifting subsequent rows, re-indexing them, and marking the editor state dirty.
c13 [kilo.c] editorDelRow frees the targeted row, shifts remaining rows down with memmove, updates indices, and increments E.dirty.
c14 [kilo.c] editorRowInsertChar pads with spaces if inserted past row size, or expands memory and shifts existing characters right.
c15 [kilo.c] editorOpen exits the process with an error message on file open failure unless errno equals ENOENT.
c16 [kilo.c] editorSave flushes rows into a single string, truncates the file descriptor with ftruncate, and writes in a single write call.
c17 [kilo.c] editorRefreshScreen flushes full terminal VT100 updates via struct abuf to avoid flickering, including row rendering, syntax, and status bars.
c18 [kilo.c] The status message at the bottom of the screen expires and disappears 5 seconds after E.statusmsg_time.
c19 [kilo.c] editorFind performs an incremental search across E.row render buffers, altering highlight bytes to HL_MATCH and restoring on exit or next match.
c20 [kilo.c] If E.dirty is non-zero, editorProcessKeypress requires Ctrl-Q to be pressed KILO_QUIT_TIMES (3) consecutive times to quit without saving.
c21 [kilo.c] Any keypress other than a qualifying Ctrl-Q resets quit_times back to KILO_QUIT_TIMES.
c22 [kilo.c] updateWindowSize subtracts 2 from E.screenrows to reserve space for the status bar.
c23 [kilo.c] When SIGWINCH is received, handleSigWinCh updates window size, clamps E.cy and E.cx within bounds, and redraws the screen.
c24 [kilo.c] initEditor initializes editor state coordinates, offsets, row list, filename, syntax, queries window dimensions, and registers SIGWINCH handling.
c25 [kilo.c] kilo requires exactly one argument for the filename and exits with status 1 if argc is not 2.
c26 [kilo.c] The main loop repeatedly calls editorRefreshScreen and editorProcessKeypress on STDIN_FILENO.

request.prompt:
Project: antirez__kilo
Below are verified claims extracted from the sources. Write up to 8 overview claims that explain how the parts fit together (architecture, main flows, cross-cutting rules). Each overview claim must list the ids of the claims that support it.

Return: {"overview":[{"text":"one sentence, max 40 words","supports":["c3","c17"]}]}

c1 [README.md] Kilo is a small text editor implemented in fewer than 1,000 lines of code as measured by cloc.
c2 [README.md] Kilo is invoked via the command line using the syntax kilo <filename>.
c3 [README.md] Keybindings in Kilo include CTRL-S to save, CTRL-Q to quit, and CTRL-F to search for a string.
c4 [README.md] Kilo does not depend on external libraries like curses and relies on standard VT100 escape sequences.
c5 [README.md] Kilo is in alpha stage and incorporates code adapted from the load81 and linenoise projects.
c6 [README.md] Kilo was created by Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez) and distributed under the BSD 2-clause license.
c7 [kilo.c] enableRawMode switches the terminal to raw mode, configures a 100 ms read timeout, and registers editorAtExit using atexit.
c8 [kilo.c] editorReadKey aborts the process with exit(1) if read() returns -1 on the terminal file descriptor.
c9 [kilo.c] getWindowSize falls back to moving the cursor to bottom-right margins and querying its position if the TIOCGWINSZ ioctl fails.
c10 [kilo.c] If a line's open multi-line comment state changes during syntax highlighting, editorUpdateSyntax recursively triggers syntax updates on subsequent rows.
c11 [kilo.c] editorSelectSyntaxHighlight checks filename matches, enforcing suffix-only matching if a pattern begins with a dot.
c12 [kilo.c] editorUpdateRow terminates the program with exit(1) if the calculated render allocation size exceeds UINT32_MAX.
c13 [kilo.c] editorInsertRow inserts an erow at index 'at', shifting subsequent rows right, reallocating E.row, and setting its idx and initial fields.
c14 [kilo.c] editorDelRow frees the row's heap buffers, shifts subsequent rows left using memmove, decrements E.numrows, and increments E.dirty.
c15 [kilo.c] editorRowInsertChar pads with spaces if the insert position exceeds row size, then updates the row and increments E.dirty.
c16 [kilo.c] editorOpen exits the program if opening filename fails with an error other than ENOENT.
c17 [kilo.c] editorSave flushes the rows string to disk using ftruncate and a single write, resetting E.dirty to 0 on success.
c18 [kilo.c] editorRefreshScreen batches escape sequences into an abuf buffer and writes them to STDOUT_FILENO in a single write call.
c19 [kilo.c] The second status bar row only renders E.statusmsg if it is non-empty and set within the last 5 seconds.
c20 [kilo.c] Pressing ESC during editorFind restores the saved cursor position (cx, cy, coloff, rowoff) and previous syntax highlighting.
c21 [kilo.c] When unsaved changes exist in E.dirty, editorProcessKeypress requires pressing Ctrl-Q three consecutive times (KILO_QUIT_TIMES) to exit.
c22 [kilo.c] Any keypress other than a repeated Ctrl-Q resets quit_times back to KILO_QUIT_TIMES.
c23 [kilo.c] editorProcessKeypress intentionally ignores CTRL_C to prevent accidental loss of file changes.
c24 [kilo.c] updateWindowSize subtracts 2 from E.screenrows to reserve room for the status bar.
c25 [kilo.c] handleSigWinCh updates the window size, clamps E.cy and E.cx to screen boundaries, and redraws the screen.
c26 [kilo.c] initEditor zeroes editor state offsets and counters, calls updateWindowSize, and installs handleSigWinCh for SIGWINCH.
c27 [kilo.c] main requires exactly one argument representing the filename, exiting with status 1 if argc != 2.
c28 [kilo.c] The main event loop continuously calls editorRefreshScreen and editorProcessKeypress on STDIN_FILENO.
